export const meta = {
  name: 'minimal-demo',
  description: 'Minimal demo: two trivial agents in parallel',
  phases: [{ title: 'Demo' }],
}

phase('Demo')
const results = await parallel([
  () => agent('Reply with exactly one word: "hello"', { label: 'agent-1' }),
  () => agent('Reply with exactly one word: "world"', { label: 'agent-2' }),
])

log(`got: ${results.join(' ')}`)
return results
